title: The 11pm session: five moves beside the bed when the day gave you nothing
caption: Quiet workout beside the bed at 11pm: Glute Bridge, Lying Heel Slide, Sit-to-Stand off the bed edge, Seated Knee Lift, Wall Push-Up. Floor and bed edge only, no jumping, nothing that wakes the house. Save this for the night the day gave you nothing else.

overlays.text: If it is 11pm and the day gave you nothing, start here.

scenes.footer: Hinge. The floor is the whole setup.

overlays.text: Glute Bridge. 10 reps. Lie on the floor, feet flat, push your hips up.

scenes.footer: Core. Slow and silent, flat on your back.

overlays.text: Lying Heel Slide. 10 reps. Stay on your back and slide one heel out and back.

scenes.footer: Squat. The bed edge is your chair.

overlays.text: Sit-to-Stand. 8 reps. Sit on the bed edge and stand up without your hands.

scenes.footer: Core. Same seat, no floor needed.

overlays.text: Seated Knee Lift. 10 reps. Back on the bed edge, sit tall, lift one knee at a time.
Wall Push-Up. 10 reps. Hands on the wall by the bed, lower your chest in, press back.
Two rounds of the five. Ten minutes, and you never leave the room.

scenes.footer: Save this for the night the day gave you nothing else.
